card.name: Homeslice
card.description: Your house as an interactive, exploded 3D view.
card.no_webgl: This browser can't show 3D graphics (WebGL is unavailable).
popup.empty: Nothing in this room is linked to Home Assistant yet.
card.view_save: Keep this view as the start view on this device
card.view_saved: Start view kept on this device
card.no_house: There is no house "{house}" in Homeslice yet.
editor.no_houses: No house yet. Create one from your Home Assistant floors and areas, or put a YAML file into the homeslice folder of your configuration and call the homeslice.import_files action.
editor.help_select: Click anything to select it: rooms, walls, doors and windows, furniture, lights, devices. Drag to move; double-click a wall to add a corner. Alt: no snapping.
editor.help_rect: Drag to draw a room. Esc: cancel.
editor.select_hint: Select a room in the plan to edit it.
editor.level_drag: Drag to reorder (top floor first), or Alt+↑/↓
editor.outline_shared: Shared by: {levels}. Moving a wall here moves it on all of them, rooms included.
editor.outline_own: This level has its own outline (e.g. an overhang); changes stay on this level.
editor.outline_hint: Drag a wall or corner. Dragging a room's outer edge moves the whole façade.
editor.outline_make_own: Give this level its own outline
editor.wall_hint: Open: no wall is built here, e.g. an open kitchen. The rooms stay separate (own area, flooring and devices).
editor.openings_hint: Click a wall to add a window, drag a door or window along its wall, Delete removes it.
editor.help_objects: Click a room to see its lights; drag a light to place it.
editor.opening_at: {at} m from the corner · {width} m wide
editor.opening_shared: Stacked on several levels ({levels}): size and position change on all of them; blind and sensor are per level.
editor.size_hint: Outside dimensions of the building; rough values are fine, you can drag the outside walls later.
editor.no_ha_floors: No floors in Home Assistant yet: the house starts with one level. Floors and areas can be linked later.
editor.new_house_rooms: Start each level with a placeholder room per area
editor.unplaced_hint: Areas of this floor in Home Assistant that are not on the plan yet.
editor.delete_level_confirm: Delete the level “{name}” with all its rooms, doors and windows? (Undo is possible until you save.)
editor.awning_hint: An awning on the house wall next to this area; it extends with the cover's position.
editor.help_stairs: Drag a rectangle where the stairwell is: from one corner to the opposite one. The stairs lead up to the next floor. Esc: cancel.
editor.stairs_hint: drag to move, corners to resize
editor.stairs_entry_hint: For stairs that start further in than the stairwell, e.g. above another stair. That strip stays floor on the level above.
card.lamp_hint: Tap: on/off · drag up or down: dim · hold: details
editor.objects_hint: Click a room to see its lights. Drag a light to where it really is; drop it into another room to move it there. Dashed: placed automatically.
editor.lights_count: {count} lights on this level, {auto} placed automatically.
editor.light_spot_add: Add a spot (drag it on the plan)
editor.no_lights: No lights in this room's area yet.
editor.light_add: Add a light from another area
editor.lights_hint: The area's lights show up here by themselves. Lights of other areas can be added, e.g. a lamp HA keeps in a different area.
editor.underlay_hint: Put a scan or photo of this floor's plan under the drawing and trace the rooms over it. It stays in Home Assistant (admins only, included in backups).
editor.underlay_move_hint: Drag to move the floor plan image. Esc: done.
editor.calib_first: Click the start of a length you know on the image (e.g. one end of a wall with its dimension).
editor.calib_distance: How long is that in reality?
editor.roof_hint: The roof shows in cards that have the roof switched on, in the overview only.
cardeditor.turn_hint: Drag the preview to turn the house into the angle this card should show.
cardeditor.interactive: Allow turning and zooming on the dashboard
cardeditor.more: The house itself is edited in the Homeslice panel in the sidebar. Room popups can be changed in YAML (popups).
cardeditor.energy: Energy overlay (solar, battery, grid and devices with their power; place them in the Homeslice panel)
editor.energy_hint: Place what makes, stores and uses power for the card's energy overlay. Their power sensors come from Home Assistant's energy settings. The lines meet at the inverter (else the battery).
editor.energy_click: Click where {name} is on this level. Esc: cancel.
editor.yaml_hint: The whole house as text: keep a copy, edit it by hand, or have an assistant write or change it, then paste it back.
editor.yaml_paste: Replace the house with this YAML
editor.paste_invalid: That is not a house model.
editor.delete_house_confirm: Delete the house “{name}” for good? Its floor plan images go too. This can't be undone.
editor.room_size_hint: Measured on the wall centre lines; changing it moves the right or bottom wall, and the rooms next to it follow.
editor.temperature_hint: Saved in the Home Assistant area, so other dashboards use it too. Empty: the area's first temperature sensor.
editor.copy_below_hint: Copies the rooms of the level below (shapes only, without areas): walls that stack line up exactly. Then rename, merge or reshape.
editor.copy_below_confirm: Replace this level's rooms with copies of the level below?
editor.export_3d_hint: The house as a glTF file, e.g. for Blender.
editor.draft: There are unsaved changes from {time} in this browser.
editor.draft_stale: There are unsaved changes from {time} in this browser, made before the house was last saved (restoring them replaces the newer version).
editor.key_nudge: Nudge stairs or energy items (Shift: 50 cm)
editor.key_corner: On a wall: add a corner; on a corner: remove it
editor.furniture_drag: drag to move (also into another room), R to turn
editor.key_turn: Turn the selected furniture (Shift: the other way)
editor.help_wall: Drag from one end of the wall to the other, e.g. a half wall in an open room; it snaps straight or to 45°. Alt: no snapping. Esc: cancel.
editor.help_measure: Drag between two points to measure; it snaps to corners and walls. Esc: done.
editor.wall_thickness_hint: Empty: like the house's other inside walls ({cm} cm).
editor.free_wall_hint: A wall that is not between two rooms. Drag its ends to move them.
editor.opening_defaults_hint: Used by every door and window without its own sill or height. For floor-to-ceiling windows: sill 0 and the storey's height.
editor.walls_hint: The outline is the outside face of the house: thicker outside walls make the rooms smaller, not the house bigger. Inside walls are centred on the lines between rooms; one wall can have its own thickness (select it).
editor.party_hint: Sides where the house shares a wall with the next house (terraced or semi-detached). Applies to every level.
editor.party_level_hint: This level has its own setting.
editor.library_hint: Drag a piece onto a room. Pieces for the wall go against the nearest wall by themselves.
editor.library_hint_room: Click a piece to put it into {room}, or drag it to its place.
editor.mount_wall_hint: Hangs on a wall, its back against it; dragging slides it along the walls.
editor.mount_ceiling_hint: Hangs from this floor's ceiling. In the exploded view it stays with this floor.
editor.merge_hint: Floors like “Outside” go onto the ground floor's level, so the garden lies next to the house.
editor.include_floors_hint: Areas of these Home Assistant floors are on this level too, e.g. an “Outside” floor with the garden.
editor.energy_link_drag: Drag onto another item to connect them
editor.energy_drag: drag it on the plan to move it
editor.energy_power_default: Empty: from Home Assistant's energy settings ({sensors}).
editor.energy_power_hint: Watts or kW. Positive means producing (solar), discharging (battery) or importing (grid).
editor.energy_to_none: Nothing (this is where the lines meet)
editor.energy_to_hint: Where its flow line goes, e.g. a wallbox to the grid meter. Or drag from the small ring next to the selected item onto another one.
editor.energy_to_hint_roof: Where the line from the panels goes, e.g. the inverter or the battery.
editor.cover_inverted: Inverted (reports open when the blind is down)
editor.awning_inverted: Inverted (reports open when the awning is rolled up)
editor.robots_hint: Robot vacuums and lawn mowers: place their dock. Cards show where they are and what they do.
editor.robot_click: Click where the dock of {name} is.
editor.robot_drag: drag its dock on the plan to move it
editor.robot_live_hint: If Home Assistant knows where the robot is (map coordinates, e.g. from Valetudo or a map extractor, or GPS), the card shows it moving. Without it, the robot shows at its dock while docked.
editor.robot_no_reading: No position right now. Some robots report it only while cleaning, or only after their own app has been opened (Roborock Q10): start a short clean, or open the app, then record.
editor.robot_calibrated: ✓ Calibrated: the card shows it live.
editor.robot_calib_hint: Let the robot stand somewhere (at its dock is fine), press Record and click where it is on the plan. Do it again with the robot somewhere else, far away. For a mirrored map, add a third spot.
editor.robot_calib_click: Click where the robot is right now.
cardeditor.mode_plan: Floor plan (2D, one floor at a time)
editor.opening_floors_hint: The same window, at the same place on the façade, on other floors (e.g. a column of windows). Size and position change on all of them together; blinds and contacts are set per floor.
editor.checklist_hint: What is left to do. Suggestions come from the areas and names of your entities; check them before linking.
editor.checklist_done: ✓ Nothing left: every area has a room, every blind and contact sensor is linked.
editor.check_unlinked: {entity} is linked to no window and is in no area.
editor.check_unlinked_room: {entity} is linked to no window; no free one fits in {room}.
cardeditor.quality_low: Low (weak wall tablets; after a reload)
cardeditor.sun: Light from the real sun, darker at night (needs sun.sun)
cardeditor.lux: Rooms as bright as their lux sensor reads, with the reading
editor.north_hint: The plan doesn't have to face north: its top is "north" in the house file. Enter which way the top of the plan really faces, in degrees east of true north (e.g. 23 if the house is turned a little clockwise). The cards light the house from the real sun with it.
editor.compass: Real north: {deg}° from the plan's top (click to change)
editor.help_opening: Click a wall to add a window, drag a door or window along its wall, Delete removes it.
editor.help_furniture: Drag a piece from the library onto a room, or select a room and click a piece.
editor.help_devices: Place solar, battery, grid, devices and robots, and connect their lines.
editor.opening_library_hint: Pick one and click a wall, or drag one onto a wall. Drag a door or window along its wall; Delete removes it.
editor.furniture_entity_hint: The entity this piece is: a floor lamp's light glows where the lamp stands; a TV or washing machine shows in the room's popup.
editor.opening_change_kind: Change it to another kind, also a door or an opening:
editor.opening_window_split: Double window over a fixed pane
editor.stairs_top: Stairs lead up to the next floor, and this is the top floor: pick a lower floor, or add a floor above.
cardeditor.presence: Mark rooms with motion or presence (leak, smoke and gas alarms always show)
editor.library_polyhaven_error: Poly Haven's catalogue could not be loaded ({error}).
editor.library_polyhaven_credit: Realistic models, free (CC0), from Poly Haven. Home Assistant downloads a model once, when you place it; every device then loads it from there.
editor.library_upload_hint: Binary glTF in metres, up to 12 MB. It is stored in Home Assistant (and its backups).
editor.library_delete_used: "{name}" is used in this house; those pieces will show simple shapes. Delete it anyway?
editor.library_model_failed: The model could not be loaded.
editor.ai_hint: Copy the prompt into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, add a photo or sketch of your floor plan, and paste its answer into the field below. The prompt explains the format and lists your floors, areas and devices, so the assistant links the right ones.
editor.ai_prompt: Copy prompt for an AI assistant
editor.ai_prompt_intro: Please draw my home for Homeslice (a Home Assistant 3D house view). I'll attach a floor plan (or describe the rooms). Follow the guide below, use only the floor, area and entity ids it lists, ask me about anything unclear, and answer with the whole house as YAML in one code block.
editor.ai_tools_hint: Assistants can also work on the house directly: Home Assistant's own assistants (add the "Homeslice" API in a conversation agent's settings) and external ones through the MCP Server integration or the HTTP API. See the README.
editor.ai_errors_text: Homeslice found these errors in the house. Please fix them and answer with the whole corrected YAML:
editor.restore_hint: Last saved {when} by {source}. Home Assistant keeps the version before that:
editor.restore_confirm: Replace the house with the version from {when} ({source})? Unsaved changes are lost; restoring again swaps back.
